# filmopen_recorder

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

The issue recorder (`docs/archive/FilmOpen-Issue Recorder.md`). While `Recorder.instance` records, every tap, drag, scroll, key, typed text, draft change, navigation, tab, route, setting and log event goes into `tape.jsonl`, with a JPEG of the whole view after each action, into a report folder beside the app's logs (`reportsDirectory()`: on Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%\FilmOpen\reports\<YYMMDDHHMMSS>\`). The folder also holds `environment.json`, the project's text files as they were at the start (`project/`) and at the stop (`project-after/`), the library's (`library/`) and the log's tail (`log.jsonl`). On the web the tape is kept in memory and nothing is written.

**Flutter.** 7 files, 1,179 lines under `lib/`; 8 tests in 2 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_recorder.dart`.
